rca_of_issues.modal_backdrop_click: The Modal component in Shared.js line 9 has onClick handler: onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) close(); }}. This should work but the backdrop click is not triggering close(). Possible causes: (1) Another element is intercepting the click, (2) The e.target === e.currentTarget check is failing, (3) Event propagation issue. X button and Escape work correctly, so the close() function itself is fine.
